description_en: Detaches a resource from a workspace. This operation does not delete the underlying resource
description_zh: 删除工作空间对资源的引用，不会删除底层的资源
name: DeleteWorkspaceResource

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated and will be removed. Use the `ResourceType` parameter instead
parameters.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，将会下线，请使用ResourceType字段
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The resource group name. To get the resource group name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449143.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源分组名。如果获取资源分组名，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449143.html
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. To get the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The deletion behavior. Valid values:

`DetachAndDelete` (default): Detaches the resource from the workspace and deletes the resource.

`Detach`: Detaches the resource from the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
删除行为，取值如下：

DetachAndDelete（默认值）：与工作空间解绑并删除资源（默认值）。
Detach：与工作空间解绑
parameters.name: option

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

`ECS`: general-purpose computing resources

`Lingjun`: Lingjun intelligent computing resources

`ACS`: ACS computing resources

`Flink`: Flink resources.

`MaxCompute`: MaxCompute resources. For this resource type, the `Option` parameter can only be set to `Detach`.

`SelfManagedAckPro`: AckPro unified management cluster resources

`SelfManagedAckLingjun`: AckLinjun unified management cluster resources

`SelfManagedASI`: ASI unified management cluster resources (third-party cloud)
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型列表。取值如下：

ECS：通用计算资源
Lingjun：灵骏智算资源
ACS：ACS计算资源
FLINK：Flink资源。
MaxCompute： MaxCompute资源，目前只支持Option为Detach，不支持DetachAndDelete
SelfManagedAckPro：AckPro统一管控集群资源
SelfManagedAckLingjun：AckLinjun统一管控集群资源 
SelfManagedASI：ASI统一管控集群资源（三方云）
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of resource IDs. All specified resources must belong to the same `GroupName`. You must specify a value for at least one of the `GroupName` or `ResourceIds` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
逗号分隔的多个资源ID，这多个资源ID的GroupName必须一致
GroupName与ResourceIds不能都为空，可以两项都不为空
parameters.name: resource_ids
